Player Impressions:
Hoyos - mental mistakes abound tonight.  Horrendous game
Jacob - a pretty good game.  Some really good defensive plays, and got the assist.  
Díaz - not a good game tonight.  a few really good plays were outweight by many bad plays
Alonso - not a good game.  at all.  Never looked up to speed.
Báez - was tasked with staying back to be more defensive tonight.  did that job well enough.  Has trouble connecting with his targets.
Amaro - Did well enough to try and control midfield.  Looked out of gas by the end.  I cannot figure out what his game plan is.  
Galoppo - fairly quiet.  He did not like coming off.
Miranchuk - didn't have a good night.  His best plays were when he came deep for recoveries.  Contributed little going forward.
Almirón - Same as normal.  Make good runs but cannot make his final passes.
Embolo - overall a good night.  Acted as an attacking midfielder a lot.  At times a 2nd striker with Miggy.  His header was exceptional.
